sharedSources.title: Public state and county market reports
sharedSources.use: Select a county, reporting period, and available property category at the source.
sharedSources.limit: County reports do not establish a municipality-level result or a value for a particular property.

sharedSources.publisher: New Jersey Department of the Treasury, Division of Taxation
sharedSources.title: Property Tax Statistics
sharedSources.use: Review the state's annual property-tax tables and their labels.
sharedSources.limit: Averages, assessments, and equalization data are not a listing price, appraisal, or future sale result.

sharedSources.title: School Performance Reports
sharedSources.use: Search current state-published reports by school, district, county, or ZIP code.
sharedSources.limit: Confirm the district and attendance assignment for the specific address; a county page cannot make that determination.

sharedSources.title: Trip Planner and Service Near a Location
sharedSources.use: Check the current route, transfer, stop, schedule, and service notices for an actual trip.
sharedSources.limit: Travel time varies by origin, destination, departure, transfers, and service conditions.

sharedSources.title: Locality Search
sharedSources.use: Confirm whether a place name is a legal municipality or a locality within another municipality.
sharedSources.limit: Postal and neighborhood names do not always match legal municipal boundaries.
